mentions.name: SourceMeta
mentions.description: This is a suite of premium tooling for working with JSON Schema, created by a member of the JSON Schema Technical Steering Committee who consults for companies using JSON Schema at large, covering fintech data domains, large OpenAPI specifications, and API governance programs. It aims to replace existing tooling that is non-compliant, half-baked, and lacks advanced features.
mentions.problem: Existing tooling for enterprise JSON Schema use cases is non-compliant, half-baked, and lacks advanced features.
mentions.source_excerpt: Premium tooling to work with JSON Schema (https://www.sourcemeta.com).
